written_by: AS7 (Sonnet 5.5) wrote the AS7b code; AS8 (Sonnet 5.5) removed the 403 handling after reading Amazon's official table
reviewer: AS8 read the diff against Amazon's official createReport error table; a fresh independent reader and the security read run on the pushed branch alongside proving
if_not_independent_why: This is the committed-for-safety step (D630); the fresh Opus reader and the security read are run on the pushed branch at the same time as proving and their findings are fixed in follow-up commits before any tag.
found: Amazon's official createReport model lists 403 as access denied, unauthorized, expired token or invalid signature, so reading 403 as 'report not covered' would hide an expired key: that handling (NotAllowed, not-allowed state, browser_keeps) was removed and 403 is a plain failure again; checks updated and counts corrected.
Looked for a day marked by=api that this run did not land: with_how_it_came marks only files this run landed or the same file already credited.
Looked at the two reports moved to the API door: the browser recipes stay as the fallback, and the extension fetches any day with no verified line.
security: No key, token or customer data is added to any file or log; the new manifest field 'by' holds api or browser only and is refused if anything else.
could_not_be_checked: Real API files for orders and returns are not seen until the first live night; the first night asks up to 14 days of returns, one ask a minute.
verify_instruction: After the first night the Drive pipeline record lines for orders and returns say by api.
